decisions.reason: The spring-controlled flap weir is close to the established offer and only mentioned briefly, so its public commitment and sunk investment are limited, but the launch is recent and any disappointing results can still be attributed to temporary causes.

The energy management system is central to the announced direction of energy recovery and intelligent control, reflecting high investment and visible commitment, so escalation pressures strongly favor keeping it.

The overflow flap gate has its own page and several models, indicating substantial sunk investment and public commitment, so dropping it would write off significant resources and expose the launch as a mistake.
